prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE spherical warrior battle sprite, transparent PNG, for a 2D arena game, legible at 32–60 pixels.
Reference image: character design and black/white engraved metal style only. REPLACE the humanoid body concept with a literal round BALL creature. The outer silhouette must be an almost perfect circle, equal width and height, with NO arms, NO legs, NO torso sticking out, NO shoulders, NO human body and NO floating portrait inside a frame.
Design the ball itself as the warrior: upper third has a few bold black swept hair locks fitted INSIDE the round silhouette, middle has a small clean ivory face with two strong determined black eyes and short angled brows, lower half is curved white steel armor wrapping around the sphere, with a single large black diamond inset on the front center and two simple layered armor seams. A dark band at the lower edge can suggest the warrior's sash. Keep the facial marks very simple, no realistic face. The entire body is the ball.
Match the source's crisp black ink outline, white steel shapes, grayscale metal shading and diamond motif, but simplify heavily. Only a handful of broad engraved hatching marks. Strong clean silhouette. Playful compact arena token with resolute warrior expression.
Composition: square canvas, centered front view, round ball fills 92% of both image width and height with only 4% transparent safe margin on every side. Fully visible circle, no crop, no oval. Mostly white surface with black hair and diamond for contrast.
Background: actual transparent alpha PNG, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no background scene or floor, no aura, no glow, no cast shadow.
No weapon or shield, no limbs, no human bust, no decorative badge border, no second circle around the character, no text, UI, labels, numbers, colors or 3D photoreal rendering. The sword is rendered and animated separately in the game.
